## Checklist
- [ ] Sources added to `research/sources.md`
- [ ] Paraphrased, with no copied documentation text
- [ ] **No real requirements text, module names from client projects, client or organization names, hostnames, credentials or personal data** (examples are synthetic)
- [ ] Rule IDs are new or unchanged (never renumbered or reused)
- [ ] `npm test` passes (`check_skill.mjs` + `test.mjs`; examples and expectations updated if a script changed)
- [ ] `adapters/core-rules.md` changed → same block copied into the other adapters
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
